urls.rationale: Title 24 Art. 6 (Colorado Sunshine Law) Part 3 - Regulation of Lobbyists is the lobbyist-registration/disclosure chapter (C.R.S. §§24-6-301 et seq.).
Title 24 Art. 6 Part 1 - General Provisions of the Sunshine Law contains definitions and scoping rules cross-referenced by the lobbying chapter (Part 3).
Article 18.5 - Independent Ethics Commission: the IEC enforces ethics rules including the gift-ban interactions that touch lobbyist disclosure obligations under Art. 6 Pt. 3.

notes: Title-24 page does NOT directly expose articles; it groups them under topical categories (e.g. 'administration', 'state-officers'). To reach the lobbying chapter required two intermediate fetches: title-24 -> administration/ -> article-6/ -> part-3 (lobbyists). Saved as pass2_title-24.tsv (category list), pass2_administration.tsv (article list under Administration; contains Article 6 Sunshine Law), pass3_article-6.tsv (parts under Article 6, including Part 3 Lobbyists). Tree depth is 4 not 3.
